text_en: This is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the Israelites before his death.
text_cn: 这是天主的人梅瑟，死前赐予以色列子民的祝福。

text_en: He said: The Lord came from Sinai, and dawned from Seir upon us; he shone forth from Mount Paran. With him were myriads of holy ones; at his right, a host of his own.
text_cn: 他说：“上主由西乃而来，从色依尔光照他的百姓，由帕兰山射出光辉，从卡德士的默黎巴前进，由他的右边有烈火发出。

text_en: Indeed, O favorite among peoples, all his holy ones were in your charge; they marched at your heels, accepted direction from you.
text_cn: 你实在爱你的人民，众圣者都在你手中；他们俯伏在你脚前，领受你的教导。

text_en: Moses charged us with the law, as a possession for the assembly of Jacob.
text_cn: 梅瑟给我们立定法律，作为雅各伯会众的产业时，

text_en: There arose a king in Jeshurun, when the leaders of the people assembled— the united tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 人民的首领与以色列支派会合时，上主在耶叔戎中作了王。

text_en: May Reuben live, and not die out, even though his numbers are few.
text_cn: 愿勒乌本生存，不至灭亡！愿他的人数不再减少！”

text_en: And this he said of Judah: O Lord , give heed to Judah, and bring him to his people; strengthen his hands for him, and be a help against his adversaries.
text_cn: 他论及犹大这样说：“上主！愿你俯听犹大的声音，领他重归自己的民族；以你的手为他交战，协助他抵抗他的仇敌！”

text_en: And of Levi he said: Give to Levi your Thummim, and your Urim to your loyal one, whom you tested at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah;
text_cn: 论及肋未说：“愿你将你的‘突明’赐给肋未，将你的‘乌陵’，赐给对你虔诚的人，就是你在玛撒曾试探过，在默黎巴水旁曾考验过的人，

text_en: who said of his father and mother, “I regard them not”; he ignored his kin, and did not acknowledge his children. For they observed your word, and kept your covenant.
text_cn: 也就是那些论及自己的父母说：我没有顾及他们，对自己的兄弟不加重视，对自己的子女也漠不关心的人！他们只遵守你的话，持守你的盟约。

text_en: They teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law; they place incense before you, and whole burnt offerings on your altar.
text_cn: 他们要将你的诫命教给雅各伯，将你的法律授给以色列；在你面前献上馨香，在祭坛上献上全燔祭。

text_en: Bless, O Lord , his substance, and accept the work of his hands; crush the loins of his adversaries, of those that hate him, so that they do not rise again.
text_cn: 上主！愿你祝福他的勇力，悦纳他手中的作为；对反抗他的人，愿你打断他们的腰，使恼恨他的人，再也不得起立！”

text_en: Of Benjamin he said: The beloved of the Lord rests in safety— the High God surrounds him all day long— the beloved rests between his shoulders.
text_cn: 论及本雅明说：“上主所钟爱的，他必安居乐业；至高者日日庇护他，住在他两肩之间。”

text_en: And of Joseph he said: Blessed by the Lord be his land, with the choice gifts of heaven above, and of the deep that lies beneath;
text_cn: 论及若瑟说：“愿他的地蒙受上主的祝福！愿天上甘露，地下深藏的渊泉，

text_en: with the choice fruits of the sun, and the rich yield of the months;
text_cn: 因太阳而出产的美果，靠月亮而出产的宝物，

text_en: with the finest produce of the ancient mountains, and the abundance of the everlasting hills;
text_cn: 太古山岳的珍品，永恒丘陵的美物，

text_en: with the choice gifts of the earth and its fullness, and the favor of the one who dwells on Sinai. Let these come on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
text_cn: 地上的宝物及其富藏，以及住在荆棘丛中者的恩惠，都临到若瑟头上，降在兄弟中为首者的头顶上！

text_en: A firstborn bull—majesty is his! His horns are the horns of a wild ox; with them he gores the peoples, driving them to the ends of the earth; such are the myriads of Ephraim, such the thousands of Manasseh.
text_cn: 他的健壮有如头胎的公牛，他的双角像是野牛的双角，用以抵触万民，直到地极。这是厄弗辣因的万军，即是默纳协的劲旅。”

text_en: And of Zebulun he said: Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
text_cn: 论及则步隆说：“则步隆！你要在旅途中喜乐；至于你、依撒加尔！你要在帐幕内欢乐。

text_en: They call peoples to the mountain; there they offer the right sacrifices; for they suck the affluence of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.
text_cn: 他们要邀请人民上山，在那里奉献应献的祭祀，因为他们要吸收海洋的富饶，沙中潜藏的珠宝。”

text_en: And of Gad he said: Blessed be the enlargement of Gad! Gad lives like a lion; he tears at arm and scalp.
text_cn: 论及加得说：“那使加得扩张的，应受赞美！他卧下仿佛一只母狮，撕裂了人的手臂和头颅。

text_en: He chose the best for himself, for there a commander’s allotment was reserved; he came at the head of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord , and his ordinances for Israel.
text_cn: 他为自己选取了为首的一分，因为那原是为首领保留的一分。他走在人民之前，执行了上主的法令，和他对以色列的旨意。”

text_en: And of Dan he said: Dan is a lion’s whelp that leaps forth from Bashan.
text_cn: 论及丹说：“丹好似由巴商跳出的幼狮。”

text_en: And of Naphtali he said: O Naphtali, sated with favor, full of the blessing of the Lord , possess the west and the south.
text_cn: 论及纳斐塔里说：“纳斐塔里，饱享恩爱，充满上主的祝福，海和南部将是他的产业。”

text_en: And of Asher he said: Most blessed of sons be Asher; may he be the favorite of his brothers, and may he dip his foot in oil.
text_cn: 论及阿协尔说：“众子中最受祝福的是阿协尔；愿他获得兄弟的恩待，在油中洗脚！

text_en: Your bars are iron and bronze; and as your days, so is your strength.
text_cn: 愿你有铜铁的门闩；愿你一生获享安宁！”

text_en: There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides through the heavens to your help, majestic through the skies.
text_cn: 没有一个像耶叔戎的天主的，他腾空驾云，在威严中来援助你。

text_en: He subdues the ancient gods, shatters the forces of old; he drove out the enemy before you, and said, “Destroy! ”
text_cn: 亘古的天主是你的避难所，他永远的手臂是你的支柱；他由你面前驱走了敌人，是他向你下命说：毁灭吧！

text_en: So Israel lives in safety, untroubled is Jacob’s abode in a land of grain and wine, where the heavens drop down dew.
text_cn: 因此，以色列能以安居乐业，雅各伯的后裔定居在产粮出酒之地，天也从上降下甘露。

text_en: Happy are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord , the shield of your help, and the sword of your triumph! Your enemies shall come fawning to you, and you shall tread on their backs.
text_cn: 以色列，你真是有福的；为上主所拯救的人民，有谁相似你？他是你护身的盾牌，是使你胜利的刀剑。你的仇敌必将奉承你，而你却要践踏他们的背脊。
